traceability.notes: Story 005.0-DEV-ANNOTATION-VALIDATION defines an ESLint rule that must validate the syntax and format of @story and @req annotations (and, by extension, @supports), support multiline and flexible parsing, and produce specific, actionable error messages. The `valid-annotation-format` rule and its helpers implement this behavior: they normalize comment lines, accumulate multi-line annotation values, validate them against configurable regex patterns, and emit detailed diagnostics for missing and invalid values. The rule documentation in docs/rules/valid-annotation-format.md clearly specifies the expected formats, default patterns, error messages, and examples, fulfilling the documentation acceptance criterion. Tests in tests/rules/valid-annotation-format.test.ts are explicitly tied to this story and its requirement IDs and comprehensively cover valid and invalid formats, multiline handling, whitespace variability, and error message contents. All these tests, along with the wider Jest suite, pass. The rule is integrated into the plugin’s recommended/strict configs and follows standard ESLint RuleTester patterns, satisfying the Quality Standards and Integration criteria. Taken together, the concrete implementation, documentation, and passing tests show that all acceptance criteria and listed requirements for this story are fully implemented.
